comments.text: The Congo Basin is extraordinary because rivers are not simply part of the landscape, they often function as the roads connecting communities that would otherwise be almost completely isolated. 🌿🛶 In places without reliable road access, fishing, transport, food and communication can all depend on waterways. That makes life in the rainforest less about being separated from civilization and more about belonging to an entirely different transportation and survival network.
